description: Exact upstream source snapshots for the limited movement, recoil, and scalar spring adaptations used by K-17.

adapted_components: Horizontal ground friction with stop speed
Wish-direction acceleration and capped air acceleration
excluded_components: Unity collision solver, capsule/box colliders, raycast tracing and step solver
Sliding, ladders, swimming, gravity and jump controller
Unity scenes, models and other assets

adapted_components: Camera recoil pitch and signed horizontal range arithmetic
excluded_components: ACS character, camera, viewmodel, remotes, inventory and damage controllers
Upstream Spring module and package dependencies
Gun recoil, roll, bipods and the delayed counter-impulse branch
components.modification_notice: TacticalRecoil.luau adapts camera pitch/horizontal arithmetic with deterministic per-weapon tuning and K-17 state; upstream archived Recoil.lua is unmodified.

adapted_components: LinearSpring.step critically damped (d == 1) scalar position/velocity update
excluded_components: Evostrike GPL-only movement, weapon, camera, inventory and gameplay code
spr Instance property scheduler, type conversions, rotation springs and other damping branches
Evostrike models, animations, sounds, maps and other assets
